summaries.name: Classic Whole Wheat Bread
summaries.summary: Classic Whole Wheat Bread is a simple, straightforward recipe yielding a slightly denser bread, which can be boosted with herbs like rosemary or thyme.

summaries.name: Honey and Oat Whole Wheat Bread
summaries.summary: Honey and Oat Whole Wheat Bread adds sweetness from honey and a nutty flavor and textural contrast from oats.

summaries.name: Garlic and Herb Whole Wheat Focaccia
summaries.summary: Garlic and Herb Whole Wheat Focaccia is an Italian-inspired bread good for sopping up chicken wing juices, with garlic and herbs complementing savory flavors. The user chose this recipe on 2023-05-23 to pair with crispy chicken wings and roasted vegetables. Tips for a good crumb: properly hydrate the whole wheat flour dough, autolyse 20-30 minutes, mix gently, and ferment at least 1 hour until nearly doubled. Tips for the crust: bake with steam (a pan of water on the oven's bottom rack) for the first 10-15 minutes, score the dough diagonally before baking, then finish with dry heat; a preheated pizza stone helps crisp the crust, and cooling on a wire rack prevents sogginess.

summaries.name: Whole Wheat Ciabatta
summaries.summary: Whole Wheat Ciabatta is a light, airy Italian bread with a slightly crispy crust and mild flavor, good for dipping into soups or olive oil.

summaries.name: Multigrain Whole Wheat Bread
summaries.summary: Multigrain Whole Wheat Bread combines whole wheat flour with other grains like oats, rye, and barley, giving a complex, nutty flavor and satisfying texture.
